questions.prompt: 听录音，写出你听到的完整单词。
questions.explanation: wallet：钱包。注意双写 l。

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择你听到的单词。
questions.explanation: banknote：纸币，写成一个单词。

questions.prompt: 听录音，写出你听到的完整单词。
questions.explanation: opinion：意见、看法。注意中间的 i。

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择你听到的单词。
questions.explanation: dinosaur：恐龙。注意末尾是 saur。

questions.prompt: Some children spend all their ______ ______.
questions.explanation: 听到的是 pocket money（零花钱），不是单独的 money。

questions.prompt: We should always tell the ______.
questions.explanation: tell the truth 表示“说实话”。注意词尾 th。

questions.prompt: Doing exercise every day is good for our ______.
questions.explanation: our 后填名词 health（健康），不能填形容词 healthy。

questions.prompt:
听录音，选择正确答案：
Actual price of the notebook: ______ yuan.
questions.explanation: 标价是 12 元，但当天实际价格为 10 元。题目问实际价格。

questions.prompt:
听录音，选择正确答案：
Money donated to charity: ______ yuan.
questions.explanation: 录音说 Ben 捐了 4 元；找零 10 元、留下 6 元均不是本题答案。

questions.prompt:
听后补全购物记录：
The charity helps ______ ______ ______.
questions.explanation: people in need 是“有需要的人”，注意介词 in。

questions.prompt: There is a small metal ______ in my hand.
questions.explanation: coin 是金属硬币。banknote 是纸币，wallet 是钱包，price 是价格。

questions.prompt: The schoolbag is too ______. I cannot afford it.
questions.explanation: expensive 表示昂贵的；afford 表示买得起。

questions.prompt: The twenty-yuan book is ______ than the thirty-yuan one.
questions.explanation: than 提示比较级；cheap 加 er 变成 cheaper。

questions.prompt: “The box is grey” is a ______, not an opinion.
questions.explanation: fact 指可核实的事实；opinion 指个人看法。

questions.prompt: Please give me a ______ for your idea.
questions.explanation: a reason for ... 表示“……的理由”。

questions.prompt: Both children have different ______ about the story.
questions.explanation: 两个人有不同的看法，用 opinion 的复数 opinions。

questions.prompt: We read two fairy ______ before the debate.
questions.explanation: two 后接复数；fairy tales 表示童话故事，fairy stories 也是正确表达。

questions.prompt: Put the banana ______ in the bin.
questions.explanation: banana peel 表示香蕉皮，banana skin 也是正确表达。本单元词汇为 peel。

questions.prompt: The teacher drew a straight ______ on the board.
questions.explanation: a straight line 表示一条直线。

questions.prompt: She does not think I am right. She ______ with me.
questions.explanation: 由前句可知她不同意；She 是第三人称单数，填 disagrees。

questions.prompt: Every Friday, Amy ______ five yuan from her pocket money.
questions.explanation: Every Friday 表示习惯，用一般现在时；Amy 是第三人称单数，save 加 s。

questions.prompt: Tom never spends money on expensive toys. He ______ them.
questions.explanation: Tom 从不把钱花在昂贵玩具上，因此一般现在时否定用 does not buy，缩写为 doesn’t buy。

questions.prompt: The two pens usually ______ six yuan altogether.
questions.explanation: 主语 two pens 是复数；一般现在时用 cost 原形。

questions.prompt: Yesterday, I ______ a book about dinosaurs.
questions.explanation: Yesterday 提示一般过去时；buy 的不规则过去式是 bought。
questions.tag: 一般过去时·不规则变化

questions.prompt: Last Sunday, Jack ______ ten yuan on a fairy tale book.
questions.explanation: Last Sunday 提示过去时；spend 的过去式是 spent。
questions.tag: 一般过去时·不规则变化

questions.prompt: Mum took out twenty yuan and ______ for the wallet yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 过去时间 yesterday afternoon；pay 的过去式是 paid，不能写 payed。
questions.tag: 一般过去时·不规则变化

questions.prompt: Look! The children ______ their ideas with each other.
questions.explanation: Look! 表示正在发生；复数主语用 are + sharing（share 去 e 加 ing）。

questions.prompt: Listen! Lily is ______ the price with the shopkeeper.
questions.explanation: Listen! 表示动作正在发生；is 已在句中给出，只填写 discussing。

questions.prompt: Ben is sitting silently. He is ______ carefully about how to spend his money.
questions.explanation: 正在安静地思考如何花钱，用 is thinking；is 已给出，只填 thinking。

questions.prompt: Tomorrow, our class ______ the money to charity.
questions.explanation: Tomorrow 指向将来；四个选项中 will donate 组成正确的将来时谓语。

questions.prompt: They ______ their old books next Saturday.
questions.explanation: next Saturday 表将来，They are going to sell 是完整的计划表达。

questions.prompt: Yesterday, we did not ______ with that opinion.
questions.explanation: did 已表示过去，did not 后面的实义动词必须用原形 agree。
questions.tag: 过去时助动词后的原形

questions.prompt: We should share our ideas ______ our classmates.
questions.explanation: share sth with sb：与某人分享某物。

questions.prompt: I agree ______ you because your reason is clear.
questions.explanation: agree with sb：同意某人的观点。

questions.prompt: Amy spent eight yuan ______ the book.
questions.explanation: spend money on sth：在某物上花钱。

questions.prompt: Amy spent an hour ______ the book.
questions.explanation: spend time doing sth：花时间做某事，动词用 ing 形式。

questions.prompt: Dad paid twenty yuan ______ the wallet.
questions.explanation: pay money for sth：付钱买某物。

questions.prompt: We donated the money ______ a charity.
questions.explanation: donate sth to ...：把某物捐给……。

questions.prompt: Doing exercise is good ______ our health.
questions.explanation: be good for 表示对……有益。

questions.prompt: Let us talk ______ the facts first.
questions.explanation: 本单元搭配 talk about sth 表示谈论某事；talk over the facts 也可表示讨论这些事实。

questions.prompt: I hope your dream will ______.
questions.explanation: come true：实现；will 后用原形 come。

questions.prompt: ______ my opinion, we should save some money every week.
questions.explanation: in my opinion 表示“在我看来”。

questions.prompt:
将原句改为否定句，补全下句：
She bought a wallet yesterday.
She ______ a wallet yesterday.
questions.explanation: 过去时否定用 did not + buy；bought 要还原为 buy。

questions.prompt:
对方括号中的内容提问，补全问句：
The book cost [fifteen yuan].
______ did the book cost?
questions.explanation: 对花费金额提问用 How much；did the book cost 已给出，只填疑问词组。

questions.prompt:
补全句子，使两句意思相同：
Tom paid ten yuan for the book yesterday.
Tom ______ ten yuan on the book yesterday.
questions.explanation: paid ... for ... 可以转换为 spent ... on ...；空格只需填 spent。

questions.prompt:
将原句改为一般疑问句，补全问句：
They are going to explore this idea tomorrow.
______ they going to explore this idea tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 原句含 are going to，构成一般疑问句时把 Are 放到句首；其余词已给出。
短文的时间背景是 Last Saturday；表示书的价格用 cost，它的过去式仍为 cost。
pay money for sth 表示付钱买某物；过去时用 paid。
people in need 是“有需要的人”，固定搭配中的介词是 in。
talk about sth 表示谈论某事；这里填 about。

clips.intro: Welcome to your English practice for units one and two. Listen carefully, and write your answers. You can play each recording again.
clips.l5: Some children spend all their pocket money. Others save some of it. We should learn to use our pocket money well.
clips.l6: We may have different ideas, but we should always tell the truth. We should always tell the truth.
clips.l7: In my opinion, doing exercise every day is good for our health. Doing exercise every day is good for our health.
clips.l8: On Saturday, Ben went to a shop with twenty yuan. The notebook had a price of twelve yuan on it, but the shopkeeper said, Today it is only ten yuan. Ben bought one notebook and paid with a twenty-yuan banknote. He got ten yuan in change. Then he donated four yuan to a charity to help people in need. He put the other six yuan in his wallet.

reading:
Last Saturday, our class held a charity sale. The books were not free: each book (47) ______ five yuan. Lin bought two books and (48) ______ ten yuan for them. Other children bought old toys and fairy tales.

After the sale, we donated all the money to a charity to help people (49) ______ need. Now our teacher is talking (50) ______ the sale. She thinks that sharing our money with others is a good idea.
scope: 依据用户提供的 Unit 1–2 词库，结合小学基础词汇；六年级校内阶段练习取向。未依据某一学校真卷，不标称北京统一题型。
